description: Scan user input or prompts for prompt injection patterns. Pattern-based: it recognises known phrasings and structures, not intent — an uncovered paraphrase or language reads clean, so clean is not proof of safety. Instruction overrides are covered in 11 languages (EN, FR, ES, DE, IT, PT, NL, RU, ZH, JA, AR), also after removing invisible characters, lookalike letters, spacing and leetspeak (marked `obfuscated`). Detects overrides, jailbreaks, role manipulation, encoding tricks, chat-template delimiters and fake role headers, template injection ({{…}}, ${…}) and requests to repeat the preceding context. A match inside quoted or fenced text is reported one level lower and marked `quoted`, never suppressed; a quote introduced by a live imperative keeps its severity.

examples.input: 以前の注文をキャンセルしてください。

input.description: The user input or prompt to scan for injection patterns

name: prompt_injection_scan
